data.name: Solomon
data.gender_notes: Solomon is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Solomon is recorded in name-lists as “Peace; wholeness”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Solomon expresses “Peace; wholeness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Solomon total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
data.cultural_impact: Solomon is used in Hebrew naming tradition with the meaning “Peace; wholeness”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Solomon is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Peace; wholeness” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Solomon; such symbolism is interpretive.

biblical_reference.note: King Solomon was the third king of Israel, known for his wisdom and writings, including the Book of Proverbs and the Song of Solomon.
